Dr. Kamal Fatema Sultana is a pediatrics specialist with 16 years of experience, focusing on pediatric cardiology. Currently serving as Associate Professor / Senior Consultant at Harmony Hospital, Dhaka.

Dr. Nur Parvez Sikder is a orthopedics specialist with 32 years of experience, focusing on joint replacement. Currently serving as Professor / Chief Consultant at Meghna Medical College Hospital, Dhaka.
Dr. Ibrahim Mahbub Dey is a oncology specialist with 9 years of experience, focusing on radiation oncology. Currently serving as Assistant Professor / Consultant at Rupsha General Hospital, Dhaka.
Dr. Sohel Sikder is a dermatology specialist with 6 years of experience, focusing on venereology. Currently serving as Assistant Professor / Consultant at Probaho Medical Centre, Chattogram.
Dr. Parvez Paul is a anesthesiology specialist with 1 years of experience, focusing on pain medicine. Currently serving as Registrar / Medical Officer at Hillside Hospital, Khulna.
